facts.fact: Eligible PMJDY account holders can get an overdraft (OD) of up to Rs 10,000
facts.quote: An overdraft (OD) facility up to Rs. 10,000 to eligible account holders is available.

facts.fact: The OD limit was raised from Rs 5,000 to Rs 10,000 in 2018
facts.quote: Existing OD limit of Rs 5,000 to be raised to Rs 10,000

facts.fact: OD up to Rs 2,000 has no conditions attached
facts.quote: There will not be any conditions attached for OD upto Rs 2,000.

facts.fact: The OD of up to Rs 10,000 is subject to eligibility conditions
facts.quote: Access to overdraft facility of upto Rs. 10,000, subject to eligibility conditions;
facts.note: That the bank applies its own conditions above Rs 2,000 is not stated on DFS/PMJDY pages (derived from the OD being a bank credit facility; fact 3 gives the no-conditions limit of Rs 2,000).

facts.fact: The age limit for OD is 18-65 years (raised from 18-60)
facts.quote: Age limit for availing OD facility to be revised from 18-60 years to 18-65 years.

summary: All confirmed: OD up to Rs 10,000 (pmjdy.gov.in, DFS), raised from Rs 5,000, no conditions up to Rs 2,000, age 18-65 (Continuation of PMJDY, 2018).
